test_only_ledger_format: Django-Redis serialized dict in physical Redis STRING; fingerprint is SHA256 of operation kind/mobile/synthetic IP/digest
operation_id_format: exactly 32 lower-case hexadecimal characters, random synthetic UUIDs
guard: Phase 7.22 and Phase 7.24 explicit CI grant; localhost-only exact fixture prefix, DB15
commit_protocol: WATCH operation ledger and mutable keys before reads; enqueue original key writes plus ledger SET EX in same MULTI; verify strict EXEC replies
issuer_transaction: 5 writes: challenge, cooldown, mobile rate, IP rate, synthetic operation ledger
verifier_transaction: 2 writes: consume/delete or failed-attempt SET XX KEEPTTL, plus synthetic operation ledger
replay_semantics: synthetic_replayed contains prior synthetic status only, never authenticated, never adds a write or extends TTL
limitations: 3900-second TTL and single-master AOF do not establish permanent idempotency: deletion, eviction, expiration, split-brain and lost writes can invalidate entries
